place.zh: 沉鼎观 · 柴房 · 雪夜
place.en: Chending Temple · The woodshed · A snowy night

setup.zh: 头场雪下了一夜。大通铺上鼾声连成一片，你摸进柴房，闩上门，把观主亲手赐的玉盒子放在柴墩上。
setup.en: The first snow falls all night. With the dormitory snoring as one, you slip into the woodshed, bar the door, and set the jade box the abbot gave you on the chopping block.

recap.zh: 雪夜，你揭了官丹的封条，让饭桶闻了一口，又拿米汤把撕破的一角粘了回去；玉盒子藏进了饭桶肚里。
recap.en: On a snowy night you broke the seal on the sect's pill, let the Rice Tub sniff it once, and pasted the torn corner back with rice water; the jade box went into the Rice Tub's belly.

zh: 头场雪。柴房里，半根蜡烛。
玉盒子，封条，观主的大印。
一颗人人都盯着的丹，最是动不得。
en: The first snow. Half a candle in the woodshed.
A jade box, a paper seal, the abbot's great stamp.
A pill everyone is watching is the hardest thing to touch.

story.zh:
拜过了师，外头下起雪来。那是那一年的头场雪，下得又密又静，一夜之间，把沉鼎山的三百级石阶埋得只剩一道白坡。

小满寻了个夜里，等大通铺上鼾声连成了一片，悄悄起身，摸到后头柴房，闩上门，点起那半根蜡烛，把玉盒子放在柴墩上，对着它坐了半晌。

他倒不是舍不得那道封条。他是在算账。

这一颗丹，是观主当着全外门一百多人的面亲手给的，上了周衡的账簿，进了全外门的眼睛。它什么时候吃，吃了以后怎样，将来人人都要问，人人都要看。一颗人人都盯着的丹，便如一个人人都盯着的人，最是动不得。

可饭桶呢？十月十二那一夜，银月睡过去之前，指着这只小铜炉，只说了半句：「它炼出来的……是你吃得下的，最好的那一颗……」他琢磨了两个月，琢磨出一个意思：它尝过什么，便炼什么；炼出来的，总是最好的那一颗。
story.en:
Once he had bowed to his master, the snow began. It was that year's first snow, thick and silent, and in a single night it buried the three hundred steps of Mount Chending until only a white slope was left.

Xiaoman picked a night, waited until the snoring on the long bunk ran together into one, got up quietly, felt his way to the woodshed at the back, barred the door, lit the half candle, set the jade box on the chopping block, and sat looking at it for a long while.

It was not the seal he couldn't bear to break. He was doing his sums.

This one pill the abbot had handed him himself, in front of the whole outer court, a hundred-odd people; it was in Zhou Heng's ledger and in the eyes of the whole outer court. When he ate it, and what came of it, everyone would ask and everyone would watch. A pill everyone is watching is like a person everyone is watching: the hardest thing of all to touch.

But the Rice Tub? On the night of the twelfth of the tenth month, before Yinyue sank into sleep, she had pointed at the little bronze furnace and said only half a sentence: "What it makes… is the best one you can swallow…" He had chewed on it for two months, and worked out this much: whatever it tastes, it makes; and what it makes is always the best one.

label.en: Break the seal and let the Rice Tub sniff it

exits.means: breaks the seal on the official pill, lets the furnace sniff it, then glues the seal back and hides the box in the furnace

story.zh:
想到这里，他便把封条揭了。

只见筑基丹端端正正躺在盒里，褐里透红，鸽子蛋大小，丹身上只一道纹，纹边上还带着两三点黑斑——一转，下品，丹毒未净。

小满把饭桶从包袱里请出来，摆在筑基丹旁边。炉盖上那只小兽先睁开一只眼睛，瞧了瞧那颗丹，又睁开另一只眼睛，跟着鼻子一抽一抽的，活像村口屠户家的老狗闻见了骨头。

小满凑过去，低声道：「……尝一口？」

炉盖「咔哒」一声，张开了。他把筑基丹举到炉口，只让它闻，闻了一下便缩回手来，缩得飞快，生怕它连丹带手一口吞了。

那颗一转的筑基丹，他原样放回玉盒。封条揭下来时撕破了一个角，他去伙房讨了半碗米汤，把那一角粘了回去。

粘好了，他举着蜡烛照了又照，照得自己都信了：这封条，从来没人揭过。

他把玉盒子也塞进了饭桶肚里，炉盖一合，「咔哒」一声，比什么锁都牢靠。

米汤粘的封条能管多久，他没想。
story.en:
Having thought it through, he broke the seal.

There lay the Foundation pill, square in its box, brown shot with red, the size of a pigeon's egg, with a single ring on it and two or three dark flecks beside the ring — one-turn, low grade, its poison not cleared.

Xiaoman brought the Rice Tub out of his bundle and set it beside the pill. The little beast on its lid opened one eye first, looked the pill over, then opened the other, and its nose began to twitch, for all the world like the butcher's old dog at the village gate smelling a bone.

Xiaoman leaned in and said under his breath: "…A taste?"

The lid went click and opened. He held the pill to the mouth of the furnace, only to let it sniff, and snatched his hand back after one sniff, fast, for fear it would swallow pill and hand together.

The one-turn pill he put back in the jade box just as it had lain. The seal had torn at one corner as it came off; he begged half a bowl of rice water from the kitchen and pasted the corner back down.

When it was glued, he held the candle up to it again and again, until even he believed it: nobody had ever broken this seal.

He tucked the jade box into the Rice Tub's belly as well; the lid closed with a click, safer than any lock.

How long a seal pasted with rice water would hold, he did not stop to think.

exits.means: eats the official pill now, uses it at once

text.zh: 一转，下品，两三点黑斑。外门里人人都知道：下品的丹，一身斑，一身毒。你把手缩了回来。
text.en: One-turn, low grade, two or three dark flecks. Everyone in the outer court knows it: a low-grade pill means spots all over and poison all through. You draw your hand back.
